And using sunscreen back then was almost unheard of. I always thought i had super oily skin so I rarely used any moisturizing products because I was always afraid of breaking out. Since I turned 50 a few months ago, I really started to pay attention to skin care and have spent A LOT of time researching products that will work for mature skin that is also oily. Once I realized that my skin looks always looks oily because I was overusing products that stripped my skin of moisture, I started to understand.
